metadata.author: V2 expansion (subagent draft)
metadata.key_test: Safeguard E POSITIVE pole. Diamond rents historically well above the 30%-of-GDP resource-curse threshold did NOT produce the curse because high-quality institutions captured the rents transparently (Pula Fund, fiscal rules). High P1 (0.632) + high rents should predict stability and growth -> validates the bidirectional design (the same rent level that drove Venezuela's collapse is benign under strong institutions).
metadata.notes: Reference-based record (country_ref + years; no embedded indicators). Resolved scores are real MI v2 re-scores. Post-1966 independence + diamond discovery -> 2024; scored ~1996 vs 2024. P2 is unavailable at pre-event (data gap). Botswana stayed Tier 2 throughout; the modest MI drift reflects the panel-wide P2 normalization and the post-windfall easing of the diamond-inflated P4, not institutional decline.

pre_event.event_description: Three decades after independence and the diamond discovery, Botswana had become Africa's longest-running multiparty democracy with strong institutions and a transparently managed mineral windfall (Pula Fund sovereign savings, sustainable-budget fiscal rule).

Botswana.notes: Inputs resolved live via mi.datasource (country_ref + year). WGI 2025-anchored 0-100. Diamond rents historically a very large share of GDP and ~half of government revenue -- above the resource-curse threshold -- but captured transparently (Pula Fund, sustainable-budget index). The POSITIVE-pole test of Safeguard E.

a_trajectory_ranking.falsification_condition: Rentier capture / authoritarian reversion / growth collapse despite high P1, i.e. the negative pole materializing

Botswana.outcome_summary: Stable positive consolidation as predicted (Tier 2 held): MI 0.702 -> 0.610, P1 0.632 -> 0.600. Among the strongest sustained growth records of any country (~9%/yr real GDP 1965/66-2005/06), upper-middle-income, no internal violence, no rentier capture. The 2024 election produced a fully peaceful handover ending the ruling party's 58-year tenure -- the strongest possible accountability signal.
key_events: decades of high growth without the resource curse
Pula Fund / fiscal-rule rent management sustained
2024 peaceful transfer of power ending 58 years of BDP rule

a_trajectory.explanation: The Safeguard E positive pole was realized: above-threshold rents under strong institutions produced stability and growth, the inverse of Venezuela. The modest MI drift is the panel-wide P2 normalization plus post-windfall P4 easing, not decline.

analysis.overall_assessment: The canonical resource-curse exception, cleanly confirmed. High P1 plus above-threshold rents produced stability and growth -- the positive pole of Safeguard E -- and the 2024 peaceful handover removed any lingering one-party-dominance doubt about accountability.
analysis.what_this_case_uniquely_reveals: Direct validation of Safeguard E's bidirectionality: the SAME rent intensity that drove Venezuela's collapse is benign -- even stabilizing -- under high-quality institutions. Resource rents are not destiny; institutional capacity sets the sign. The 2024 alternation also retires the 'stability is just one-party entrenchment' objection.
analysis.baseline_impact: None; calibrates the Safeguard E positive pole alongside Venezuela (negative), Mongolia (mixed) and the Gulf (authoritarian positive).
